facts.text: Earlier ProFTP was running but now ProFTP is not running.
My Apache and ProFTP are not running.
Last time I added one line to the ProFTP configuration file and it was running.

keyphrases: added one line to proftp config

events.text: ProFTP stopped running after previously running.
Apache and ProFTP were not running.
